# Gladhat — Commercial Strategy & Positioning Consultancy

> Commercial strategy, positioning, and clear communication for founders who value clear thinking. Founded by Michael Simkin.

## Overview
Gladhat is a boutique commercial strategy consultancy that helps B2B founders, tech leaders, and growing companies clarify their market positioning, articulate their unique value, and uncover hidden growth opportunities through deep customer insights and strategic messaging.

## Founder
- **Name**: Michael Simkin
- **Role**: Commercial Strategy Consultant & Founder
- **Email**: m@gladhat.com
- **Website**: https://gladhat.com

## Core Services & Philosophy
- **Customer & Buyer Research**: Seeing through the buyer's eyes to uncover what customers actually value.
- **Strategic Positioning**: Helping companies stand out by clarifying who they serve, what problem they solve, and why it matters.
- **Commercial Messaging & Narrative**: Translating complex technology or services into intuitive, compelling stories for buyers and investors.
- **Founder Advisory**: Serving as a respectful, outside strategic sounding board when business decisions feel stuck or complex.
